entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:1
segments: ¶Walk prudently when you go to the house of God; and draw near to hear rather than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they do not know that they do evil.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:2
segments: Do not be rash with your mouth, And let not your heart utter anything hastily before God. For God [is] in heaven, and you on earth; Therefore let your words be few.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:3
segments: For a dream comes through much activity, And a fool's voice [is known] by [his] many words.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:4
segments: ¶When you make a vow to God, do not delay to pay it; For [He has] no pleasure in fools. Pay what you have vowed-

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:5
segments: Better not to vow than to vow and not pay.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:6
segments: Do not let your mouth cause your flesh to sin, nor say before the messenger [of God] that it [was] an error. Why should God be angry at your excuse and destroy the work of your hands?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:7
segments: For in the multitude of dreams and many words [there is] also vanity. But fear God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:8
segments: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent perversion of justice and righteousness in a province, do not marvel at the matter; for high official watches over high official, and higher officials are over them.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:9
segments: ¶Moreover the profit of the land is for all; [even] the king is served from the field.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:10
segments: He who loves silver will not be satisfied with silver; Nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:11
segments: When goods increase, They increase who eat them; So what profit have the owners Except to see [them] with their eyes?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:12
segments: The sleep of a laboring man [is] sweet, Whether he eats little or much; But the abundance of the rich will not permit him to sleep.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:13
segments: There is a severe evil [which] I have seen under the sun: Riches kept for their owner to his hurt.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:14
segments: But those riches perish through misfortune; When he begets a son, [there is] nothing in his hand.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:15
segments: As he came from his mother's womb, naked shall he return, To go as he came; And he shall take nothing from his labor Which he may carry away in his hand.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:16
segments: And this also [is] a severe evil-Just exactly as he came, so shall he go. And what profit has he who has labored for the wind?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:17
segments: All his days he also eats in darkness, And [he has] much sorrow and sickness and anger.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:18
segments: ¶Here is what I have seen: [It is] good and fitting [for one] to eat and drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labor in which he toils under the sun all the days of his life which God gives him; for it [is] his heritage.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:19
segments: As for every man to whom God has given riches and wealth, and given him power to eat of it, to receive his heritage and rejoice in his labor-this [is] the gift of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 5:20
segments: For he will not dwell unduly on the days of his life, because God keeps [him] busy with the joy of his heart.
